dedupe_keys.name: urban nature based solutions to climate change adaptation database

description: Sean Goodwin and colleagues publish a spreadsheet of 216 urban nature-based interventions in 130 cities across 55 countries. Zenodo serves version 1.0.0 under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The authors screened 823 potential entries and coded the included interventions by climate, biodiversity and social challenges and by the degree of change they sought. The workbook includes a coding template that explains those classifications. Modellers can use the cases to define plausible green-blue infrastructure options or compare adaptation scenarios across cities. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this intervention database. A limitation is that the table documents interventions and classifications, not measured cooling, flood reduction or other performance parameters for a physical simulation. The published cases depend on the source-screening date and may omit newer projects. The XLSX was not downloaded, so row count, individual city entries and coding consistency were not independently checked.
